scope: Actual definitions, purchase/refund rules and runtime helper outputs on unequipped synthetic characters; not combat execution, player timing, balance or coverage proof.

definitions.name: Cleave
definitions.description: Swing in a wide arc, dealing {coef} weapon damage to all enemies caught in the swing. Generates {gen} Fury per swing.

tiers.name: Momentum
tiers.desc: Each swing grants 3% attack speed for 3 seconds, stacking 5 times.

runes.name: Rupture
runes.desc: Enemies slain by Cleave explode, dealing 120% weapon damage to nearby enemies.

runes.name: Broad Sweep
runes.desc: The swing covers a much wider arc and deals 30% more damage.

runes.name: Gathering Storm
runes.desc: Cleave deals Lightning damage and generates 3 additional Fury.

definitions.name: Whirlwind
definitions.description: Become a whirling storm of steel, dealing {coef} weapon damage per second to all enemies around you while you move. Costs {cost} Fury per second. Starts automatically at 25 Fury when enemies are near.

runes.name: Dust Devils
runes.desc: Every second you whirl, unleash a Dust Devil that wanders through enemies for 3 seconds, dealing 120% weapon damage per second.

runes.name: Blood Funnel
runes.desc: Critical hits heal you for 1.5% of your maximum Life.

runes.name: Volcanic Eruption
runes.desc: Whirlwind deals Fire damage and its radius is increased by 30%.

definitions.name: Rend
definitions.description: Tear into all nearby enemies, causing them to bleed for {coef} weapon damage over {duration} seconds. Cast automatically when 3+ unbleeding enemies are near.

tiers.name: Contagion
tiers.desc: When a bleeding enemy dies, its bleed spreads to up to 3 nearby enemies.

runes.name: Ravage
runes.desc: Rend reaches 40% further.

runes.name: Bloodlust
runes.desc: Heal for 0.5% of maximum Life per enemy bleeding, every second.

runes.name: Lacerate
runes.desc: Rend deals 60% more damage.

definitions.name: Ground Stomp
definitions.description: Smash the ground, dealing {coef} weapon damage and stunning nearby enemies for {duration} seconds. Generates {gen} Fury.

runes.name: Wrenching Smash
runes.desc: Pull enemies from up to 320 units away into the stomp.

runes.name: Jarring Slam
runes.desc: Stunned enemies take 30% more damage from all sources.

runes.name: Foot of the Mountain
runes.desc: Deals 200% more damage as Fire and generates 10 more Fury.

definitions.name: Seismic Slam
definitions.description: Send a fissure through the earth, dealing {coef} weapon damage to all enemies in a 60° cone.

tiers.name: Wide Rift
tiers.desc: Cone is 35% wider and reaches further.

runes.name: Shattered Ground
runes.desc: Deals Fire damage and knocks enemies back further.

runes.name: Permafrost
runes.desc: Deals Cold damage and chills enemies by 60% for 2 seconds.

runes.name: Rumble
runes.desc: The ground continues to shake, dealing an additional 100% of the damage over 1 second.

definitions.name: Battle Rage
definitions.description: Enter a rage that increases damage by 10% and Critical Hit Chance by 3% for {duration} seconds. Recast automatically.

runes.name: Into the Fray
runes.desc: Critical hits generate 4 Fury.

runes.name: Marauder's Rage
runes.desc: Increases the damage bonus to 25%.

runes.name: Ferocity
runes.desc: Also increases Critical Hit Damage by 25%.

definitions.name: Hungering Arrow
definitions.description: Fire a magically imbued arrow that seeks out enemies for {coef} weapon damage, with a 35% chance to pierce. Generates {gen} Hatred.

runes.name: Puncturing Arrow
runes.desc: Pierce chance increased by 50%.

runes.name: Shatter Shot
runes.desc: Piercing splits the arrow into 3 smaller arrows dealing Cold damage.

runes.name: Devouring Arrow
runes.desc: Each consecutive pierce deals 70% more damage.

definitions.name: Sentry
definitions.description: Deploy a turret at your feet that fires bolts at enemies for {coef} weapon damage each second. Up to {max} Sentries; lasts {duration} seconds.

tiers.name: Custom Engineering
tiers.desc: +1 maximum Sentry and Sentries last 50% longer.

runes.name: Spitfire Turret
runes.desc: The turret also fires homing rockets dealing 120% weapon damage as Fire.

runes.name: Chain of Torment
runes.desc: Lightning chains form between your Sentries, dealing 300% weapon damage per second to enemies that cross them.

runes.name: Polar Station
runes.desc: Bolts deal Cold damage and chill enemies by 60%.

definitions.name: Multishot
definitions.description: Fire a massive volley of arrows in a wide arc, dealing {coef} weapon damage to every enemy hit.

runes.name: Fire at Will
runes.desc: Deals Lightning damage and costs 40% less Hatred.

runes.name: Arsenal
runes.desc: Also fires 3 rockets at nearby enemies for 300% weapon damage as Fire.

runes.name: Full Broadside
runes.desc: Multishot deals 50% more damage.

definitions.name: Cluster Arrow
definitions.description: Lob an explosive arrow into the densest pack. It detonates for {coef} weapon damage as Fire, then releases 4 grenades for 210% weapon damage each.

runes.name: Maelstrom
runes.desc: Releases 3 homing rockets instead of grenades.

runes.name: Shooting Stars
runes.desc: Deals Lightning damage; grenades become falling stars.

runes.name: Loaded for Bear
runes.desc: Explosion radius +40% and +80% damage, but no grenades.

definitions.name: Rain of Vengeance
definitions.description: Call down a storm of arrows on a large area, dealing {coef} weapon damage over {duration} seconds.

runes.name: Dark Cloud
runes.desc: Deals Lightning damage; the storm follows the densest pack.

runes.name: Beastly Bombs
runes.desc: Deals Fire damage and 50% more damage in a shorter burst.

runes.name: Stampede
runes.desc: Cooldown reduced by 33%.

definitions.name: Companion
definitions.description: A loyal wolf fights at your side, biting enemies for {coef} weapon damage.

runes.name: Pack Leader
runes.desc: Your wolf howls, increasing your damage by 15%.

runes.name: Bat Companion
runes.desc: A bat replaces the wolf and generates 1 Hatred per second.

runes.name: Raven Companion
runes.desc: A raven replaces the wolf, dealing Lightning damage and 50% more.

definitions.name: Magic Missile
definitions.description: Launch a missile of arcane energy, dealing {coef} weapon damage as Arcane.

runes.name: Seeker
runes.desc: Missiles home in on enemies and deal 30% more damage.

runes.name: Split
runes.desc: Fire 3 missiles that each deal 60% of the damage.

runes.name: Glacial Spike
runes.desc: Deals Cold damage and has a 15% chance to freeze for 1 second.

definitions.name: Meteor
definitions.description: Summon a meteor onto the densest pack. After a short delay it impacts for {coef} weapon damage as Fire and leaves molten ground that burns for 235% weapon damage over {duration} seconds.

runes.name: Star Pact
runes.desc: Meteor costs 20 more Arcane Power but deals 70% more damage.

runes.name: Comet
runes.desc: Deals Cold damage and freezes enemies hit for 1.5 seconds.

runes.name: Meteor Shower
runes.desc: Summon 7 smaller meteors across the area, each dealing 37% of the damage.

definitions.name: Black Hole
definitions.description: Tear open a black hole that pulls enemies within {radius} units to its centre and deals {coef} weapon damage as Arcane over {duration} seconds. Pairs perfectly with Meteor.

runes.name: Event Horizon
runes.desc: Pull radius increased by 40%.

runes.name: Spellsteal
runes.desc: Gain 3% damage for 10 seconds per enemy caught.

runes.name: Absolute Zero
runes.desc: Deals Cold damage and freezes enemies when it collapses.

definitions.name: Frost Nova
definitions.description: Blast a ring of frost, dealing {coef} weapon damage as Cold and freezing nearby enemies for {duration} seconds.

runes.name: Shatter
runes.desc: Frozen enemies that die explode into another Frost Nova.

runes.name: Bone Chill
runes.desc: Frozen enemies take 33% more damage.

runes.name: Deep Freeze
runes.desc: Gain 10% Critical Hit Chance for 11 seconds when 5+ enemies are frozen.

definitions.name: Hydra
definitions.description: Summon a three-headed Hydra that spits fireballs for {coef} weapon damage per second as Fire. Lasts {duration} seconds.

runes.name: Arcane Hydra
runes.desc: Spits Arcane orbs that explode on impact.

runes.name: Frost Hydra
runes.desc: Breathes cones of frost that chill enemies.

runes.name: Mammoth Hydra
runes.desc: A single massive Hydra breathes a river of fire, dealing 70% more damage.

definitions.name: Magic Weapon
definitions.description: Imbue your weapon with arcane power, increasing damage by 10% for {duration} seconds. Recast automatically.

runes.name: Ignite
runes.desc: Your attacks burn enemies for 100% weapon damage over 3 seconds.

runes.name: Electrify
runes.desc: Your attacks have a 25% chance to arc lightning to 3 enemies for 100% weapon damage.

runes.name: Force Weapon
runes.desc: Increases the damage bonus to 20%.
